blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III and a delegation of lawmakers brought LegisHear to the Jose Rizal Coliseum in Calamba, Laguna, on Friday to discuss with residents and other stakeholders a comprehensive flood mitigation and management plan for the Laguna Lake Basin. Laguna Gov. Sol Aragones and Calamba City officials welcomed the group to the event, which was hosted by Calamba City Lone District Rep. Charisse Anne “Cha” Hernandez. The consultation allowed the affected communities to raise concerns and share recommendations to address recurring flooding, protect livelihoods, and improve the condition of Laguna de Bay.
